entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been waiting forever. I need to return this jersey I bought. It's completely unacceptable.

I'm very sorry to hear that you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

What do you mean, 'preference'? It's the wrong size! It's way too tight! I can't even zip the thing up. This is absolutely ridiculous. I've spent thousands of dollars with you people. Get me a manager, right now.

I completely understand your frustration, and I assure you, I can resolve this for you without needing to escalate the call. I see here you're one of our VIP customers, and we certainly appreciate your loyalty. Let me just confirm the purchase date for you. It looks like it was delivered about 58 days ago, is that right?
Yeah, around then. So what? Are you going to tell me it's too late? I swear, if you do, I'm taking my business elsewhere and I'll make sure everyone knows about it.

Not at all. I was just confirming. For a standard item like a jersey, our policy allows for returns up to 90 days. You are well within that window. I can absolutely process a return for you. Would you prefer a full refund, or would you like me to set up an exchange for a different size?
Oh. You... you can just do that? I thought it was going to be a whole big fight.

No fight necessary. I've just initiated a full refund back to your original payment method. You'll receive a pre-paid return label in your email within the next 15 minutes. And for the trouble and as a thank you for being a VIP member, I've also added a $25 credit to your account for your next purchase.
A full refund and a credit? Wow. Okay. That's... that's actually great. I wasn't expecting that. Thank you, David.
You're very welcome. We want to make sure you're happy with your gear. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again for your help.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
